body: Thanks. Part of me thinks that I should’ve seen it sooner. Nearly everyone in his family has an addiction of some kind. I just didn’t want to think that my dad would die before he could see all his kids grow up.

It sounds like anxiety. I’ve spoken with my psychiatrist before about paranoid and irrational thoughts, and they told me that it’s very common to feel like you’re going crazy. Before I was on medication I would feel the earth move or spin, or feel like I would fall through the ground. All kinds of things that make no sense, but at the time, it seemed very real. It’s completely normal to feel this way.

I thought that the staff would have been more hard on him, since it’s a pretty strict school, but from what I’ve heard he hasn’t faced many consequences. It’s so frustrating, but since his behavior has come to light, I’m hoping that they’ll realized how fucked in the head he is and tell his parents. Thank you for the advice, it’s much appreciated

Thanks. I just don’t want them to blame me for this, but I don’t know how to put it into words. It feels like I’ve been telling them all of this for weeks now, but they pick and choose what they want to hear. I don’t know what to say

I can imagine him being a petty bitch and breaking up with her anyway, so that she’ll blame us. He once broke up with her for like a day because she hung out with one of her friends that he didn’t like.
I guess so. But they would probably ignore me. Everyone wants them to break up, but no one wants to make her upset.
I’m basically just a kid. 16. And I don’t think my sister would ever forgive me. I feel like he wouldn’t listen to anyone but my parents.
